scope: 17 corpus cases use authored local files, real rg, byte/hash/ignore/path/symlink and size/count limits.
16 retrieval cases use real rg and controlled Node scripts named QMD or rg; no installed QMD, index, model or inference is used.
17 CLI cases execute actual Node entry/local commands and mock remote fetch without HTTP requests.

limits: This exact run is 62 pass and one failure; it is not a successful 63-case acceptance. There was no retry or product/test source edit.

All fixtures stayed within the small disposable scope (roughly 17 MiB and up to 1001 tiny files). The outer directory was empty and identity-checked/removed, but this does not establish the failed descendant-termination proof.
No real QMD, provider/model, HTTP network, private corpus, registered native client, hosted service, account, database, installation, clone, build, CI or paid resource was exercised.
The separate completed 34-case MCP receipt is unchanged; it did not claim OS-child termination proof.
Only the selected copy's executable metadata repair and these two local result files were written. Canonical publication and any next execution profile belong to root.
